A spring has an unstretched length of 3.0cm. When a force of 60N is applied to the spring, its
length increases to 5.0cm. The limit of proportionality is not exceeded.
What is the spring constant of the spring?
A
7.5N/cm
B
12N/cm
C
20N/cm
D
30N/cm
subject: Physics
